title: Bitcoin rebounds above $60K, shorts lose $278M | Daily Brief
caption:
bitcoin bounced from a $57,208 low back to ~$60,734 (+4.7% in 24h) 📈 eth +4.5% to $1,704, sol +6.2% to $70.89. $368m liquidated in 24h, $278m of it shorts. but btc etfs lost $453m wednesday and $5.39b in november, a record month. fear & greed index at 11. today: ~$7b in btc options expire on deribit, us stocks close early, december fed hike expected. levels to watch: $61k-$62k, $57k-$58k. not financial advice.
